query: Explain how `extract_text_to_fp` in `pdfminer/high_level.py` converts a PDF into output: how it chooses the output device for each output type and what happens for an unsupported type, how it prepares the output stream and the resource manager (including caching), how the scale, layout and rotation options take effect, and how it processes the pages and finishes.

operations.name: The output device is a text, XML, HTML or hOCR converter depending on the output type
operations.needed_for: how it chooses the output device for each output type

operations.name: An unsupported output type raises a value error
operations.needed_for: what happens for an unsupported type

operations.name: Standard output is replaced by its binary buffer when a non-text output type is written to it
operations.needed_for: how it prepares the output stream

operations.name: The requested rotation is added to each page's own rotation modulo 360
operations.needed_for: how the rotation option takes effect

operations.name: Every selected page is interpreted and the device is closed at the end
operations.needed_for: how it processes the pages and finishes

dependencies.name: Caching is controlled by one flag that feeds both the resource manager and the page loader
dependencies.needed_for: how it prepares the resource manager (including caching)

dependencies.name: Scale and layout mode only influence the HTML converter
dependencies.needed_for: how the scale and layout options take effect

dependencies.name: For tag output the stream is cast to a binary stream before it is given to the tag extractor
dependencies.needed_for: how it prepares the output stream (binary stream for tag output)

revisions.reviewer_note: remove incidental debug/image-writer requirements or make them explicitly relevant
revisions.change: Removed the debug-logging and image-writer operations. The question no longer asks 'which options it honours'; it asks about device choice, stream and resource-manager preparation, scale/layout/rotation and page processing. Rotation and the stdout buffer moved from dependencies to operations; a tag-extractor binary-stream dependency was added so there are 5 operations and 3 dependencies.
